source.author: verg
source.text: Fit sonitus spumante salo; iamque arva tenebant, ardentisque oculos suffecti sanguine et igni, sibila lambebant linguis vibrantibus ora.
source.text_original: Fit sonitus spumante salo; iamque arva tenebant, / ardentisque oculos suffecti sanguine et igni, / sibila lambebant linguis vibrantibus ora.
source.text_english: A noise is made in the foaming sea; and now they held the fields, and, their eyes suffused with blood and fire, they licked their hissing mouths with quivering tongues.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: o qui spumantia nutu regna quatis terrasque salo complecteris omnes, da veniam.
reuse.text_original: 'o qui spumantia nutu / regna quatis terrasque salo complecteris omnes, / da veniam.
reuse.text_english: O you who with a nod shake the foaming kingdoms and embrace all lands with the sea, grant pardon.
